#!/bin/sh
CONFIG_DIR="/config/openvpn"
mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR"
echo "=== Fetching VPN Config ==="
curl -sf -o "${CONFIG_DIR}/client.ovpn" "${BACKEND_URL}/api/v1/proxy/lease/openvpn"
if [ ! -s "${CONFIG_DIR}/client.ovpn" ]; then
  echo "Failed to fetch config, sleeping 60s"
  sleep 60
  exit 1
fi
exit 0
